title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids to Improve Depression and Reduce Cardiovascular Risk Factors

sections.abstract:
This study will determine the effects of omega-3 fatty acid (FA) augmentation of sertraline on depression and cardiac endpoints after myocardial infarction (MI).

Posted outcomes: Beck Depression Inventory-II. timeframe=Measured at Baseline and 10 weeks. Sertraline Plus Omega-3 Supplement=16.1 (±10.2); Sertraline/Corn Oil=14.8 (±9.7)
